drop the lock acquisition from the rotate path entirely (read-rotate-write runs unserialised)
ignore --no-rotate and rotate anyway (a read-only/dry-run lookup resumes spending a destructive rotation)

mutations.new:

print the rotated token beside the path on the success route (the leak assertion must fire, with --forge still wired)

rename the rotated token over the custody PATH instead of the link's resolved target (a symlinked custody layout is replaced by a regular file and the provisioned file is stranded holding the invalidated token)

mutations.name: restore a default API base (an unset GITLAB_API_BASE resumes probing a guessed host with the live PAT)
drop the group/other-WRITE refusal from the private-key mode rule (a 0660/0620 key becomes acceptable)
drop the other-READ refusal from the private-key mode rule (a 0644/0604 key becomes acceptable)
accept every private-key mode (the checker stops being a guard at all)
coverage: a failed repository page becomes a SHORT list read as complete (drop the exit-6 refusal; return the partial list)

mutations.name: coverage: print the enumeration token beside the installation header (the no-token-leak assertion must fire)
coverage: --repo matches on the bare name, not full_name (a same-named repo in another org matches the wrong installation)
coverage: render installations in API order, not sorted by account.login (two runs differ)
coverage: stop refusing GitLab (the verb runs against a forge that has no installation to enumerate)
mutations.old:
case "gitlab":
		return deskkit.Refused("coverage is GitHub-only: a GitLab PAT has no App installation to enumerate")

mutations.name: role->App binding: remove the binding lookup (appNameFor returns the role's own default unconditionally, ignoring the <ROLE>_APP binding) — the --version bindings echo must redden
drop the App-name half of the owner-sidecar comparison (two Apps on one account start sharing a token cache file)
relax the cache probe's single-match rule to first-match (two distinct fresh candidates stop being ambiguous and one is picked)
drop the 0600 custody check on a probe candidate (a world-readable token file becomes reusable)
drop the reuse-window check on a probe candidate (a token past its 50-minute window is adopted)
remove the account character-set check (a malformed account name is interpolated into a cache path)
widen the install-id cache TTL tenfold (a stale installation id is trusted for ten days)
let --fresh honour the caches (a re-mint after a permission change becomes a no-op for the rest of the reuse window)

mutations.new:

mutations.name: drop the 404 invalidation route (a stale cached installation id fails every call for its whole TTL)
unscope the 404 invalidation from cached ids (an operator's <PREFIX>_INSTALL_ID failure deletes a cache it never used)
